scholarships.title: Western Sydney University Research Scholarship - Spring Release, Quarter 1 2027 commencement

existing.funding_period: per annum (2026 release value) for three years
eligibility: Be a new applicant applying to commence a doctoral program, have commenced a doctoral program in 2026, or hold an offer to commence a doctoral program in Q1 2027
Be able to study full time commencing in Q1 2027
Be able to be onshore in Australia at the scholarship commencement date
International applicants must have completed an MPhil or MRes at Western Sydney University in 2025 or 2026, or be currently enrolled and under examination in one
Domestic applicants are Australian citizens, permanent residents and New Zealand citizens
Must not already hold a top-up scholarship, as WSU does not award them
existing.eligibility_summary: For domestic applicants and for international applicants who have completed or are completing an MPhil or MRes at Western Sydney University, applying to commence a doctoral program in Quarter 1 2027 or who commenced one in 2026. All recipients must study full time and be onshore in Australia at the scholarship commencement date.
benefits: $38,707 (AUD) stipend per annum for three years
Paid employment permitted provided it does not interfere with study
No requirement to undertake tutoring or other academic employment at Western Sydney University
coverage: Stipend of AUD 38,707 per annum for three years
Tuition fees covered by the Australian Government Research Training Program
requirements: Complete and submit the Standardised Applicant CV - applications without it will not be considered
Submit an expression of interest for the relevant doctoral degree via the application portal and select the Q1 2027 Scholarship Release
Wait to be invited by the relevant School or Institute to submit a full application
All required documents must be provided before the closing date
documents: Standardised Applicant CV using the Candidate CV Template 2027 Q1
Research proposal and details of the proposed supervisor
Expression of interest submitted through the application portal
application_method: Submit an expression of interest for the relevant doctoral degree via the application portal and select the Q1 2027 Scholarship Release
If shortlisted, submit a full application with all required documents before the closing date
Existing WSU doctoral candidates who commenced in 2026 submit their CV via the scholarship form in WesternNow
existing.selection_notes: Research scholarships are awarded on a competitive basis by a Western Sydney University appointed ranking panel, following the Guidelines for Ranking Higher Degree Research Scholarships. Western Sydney University receives a high volume of applications and states that incomplete applications or applications that do not meet the requirements may not be considered. The application process, eligibility criteria, ranking criteria and guidelines are subject to revision.
existing.best_fit: Doctoral candidates already connected to Western Sydney University - especially international applicants who completed or are completing an MPhil or MRes there - who need full tuition and a stipend to start a PhD in Quarter 1 2027 and can be onshore in Australia from January 2027.
existing.notes: Scholarships explicitly exclude travel costs, visa costs, relocation expenses and other expenses. Top-up scholarships are not available. Recipients are expected to undertake a minimum of 35 hours per week of study throughout the year. Part-time awards may be offered but are taxable.
existing.duration: Stipend for three years; tuition fees covered for the degree duration
existing.application_period: Western Sydney University Spring Release for Quarter 1 2027 commencement: applications opened Friday 18 September 2026 and close 11.59pm AEDT Sunday 18 October 2026. Successful applicants must commence Monday 4 January 2027. The next release, the Autumn Release, opens sometime in March or April 2027.
